item.title: Version 1.0.0-beta.2 (65)
item.description:
Trails RG Studio 1.0.0-beta.2

Build 65

  • Each scene splits into Accept and Reject, with the frame and the sharpest patch beside it
  • Keep the sharpest one, two, or three frames, and split or join a scene when the group is wrong
  • Accept and Reject are written to a sidecar Lightroom can read
